target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft module implementing one Raft group per Node/RawNode; caller provides transport, durable persistence, ticks and state-machine application. In-repository storage and configuration helpers remain inside investigation scope.
ownership: Node serializes raft state; RawNode requires caller serialization. Disk/network/application effects belong to embedding caller under documented duties.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader aggregates term-qualified append responses using current voter quorums and current-term commitment; followers enforce prefix matching and consume commit propagation.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Election, pre-vote, higher terms, quorum checks and transfer control authority. Reset discards context-specific support while preserving decided history.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Storage restart, snapshot installation and replication probing reconstruct eligible participation; caller owns actual durability.
Committed changes applied by caller install simple or joint quorums, learners and automatic-exit policy.
Ready exposes committed entries subject to snapshot and storage boundaries; completion separately updates applied state and backpressure.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Library defers support publication through caller storage completion; Storage supplies persisted history and restart state.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Node/RawNode expose proposals and read indices; proposals can be dropped and require caller retry, reads require identity and applied-state interpretation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and applied voter configuration
implementation_guards: Reject proposals while transferring leadership or after local removal; serialize configuration proposals through pendingConfIndex.
Only tracked peers reach response handler; quorum uses configured voters, jointly when required; maybeCommit additionally requires the entry term to equal leader term.
writes: Append proposal at current term and next index. Successful acknowledgement monotonically updates peer Match; quorum calculation may advance committed.
external_effects: New proposals broadcast appends. MsgAppResp-driven commitment releases pending reads and broadcasts commit; this follow-up is specific to this caller.
async_boundaries: Local self acknowledgement and remote acknowledgements wait for persistence through B-persist.

cross_activity_effects.A5: Committed prefix becomes eligible for Ready delivery subject to local storage and application backpressure.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.Step, campaign, stepCandidate, reset and tick functions
behaviors.protocol_context: Local term, role, Vote, leader and current voter set
behaviors.trigger: Election timeout, campaign request, vote reply, higher-term traffic, quorum check or leadership transfer
implementation_guards: Campaign requires local voter eligibility and no unapplied committed configuration entry.
Vote requires repeat/unassigned vote or future pre-vote plus log freshness; election counts current configured voters.
Candidate consumes only the response type for its current election phase. Lower-term replies are dropped; pre-vote has explicit future-term exceptions.
writes: Real candidacy increments term and records self vote; quorum win becomes leader and appends a no-op. Reset clears votes, progress estimates and readOnly acknowledgements, retains log commitment and rebuilds local progress.
Higher-term ordinary traffic steps down; checkQuorum can step down within the same term. Transfer pauses proposals, catches target up and sends TimeoutNow; timeout aborts transfer.
async_boundaries: Self vote is deferred through persistence just like remote vote responses.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Term and role qualify support; newly elected leader must collect support for a current-term entry before advancing commit. Prior committed history remains protected.

unknowns: pendingReadIndexMessages is separate from reset readOnly state; the intended lifetime of pre-commit requests across leadership changes needs focused investigation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Follower receiving current or higher-term leader traffic after Step dispatch
implementation_guards: Append checks predecessor term, refuses conflict with committed entries and bounds commitment by the last matching/appended entry.
Heartbeat commit is bounded at its producer by peer Match.
writes: Refresh known leader/election timer; reconcile unstable suffix and increase committed prefix.
external_effects: Append replies use deferred persistence; heartbeat replies return context immediately.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Matching established log history constrains later candidate freshness.

Term-qualified storage completion stabilizes matching entries; obsolete-term append completion is ignored, but snapshot completion is processed.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Support acknowledgements are published after the storage required by their producer.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Persisted term and vote constrain authority after restart.

implementation_guards: Simple changes alter at most one voter; joint changes retain outgoing voters until LeaveJoint.
No resulting zero-voter configuration; removed/demoted leader may step down according to option.

implementation_guards: Ignore obsolete snapshots; only restore while follower and when recipient belongs to snapshot configuration.
Matching snapshot log term fast-forwards commitment without replacing log; otherwise restore unstable snapshot and configuration.
Promotability blocks while a snapshot is outstanding.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft read-index handling and caller consuming ReadState
behaviors.protocol_context: RequestCtx identity, leader term, committed index and readOnly quorum acknowledgements
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex request, current-term commit release, heartbeat acknowledgement
legal_preconditions: Caller uses RequestCtx to distinguish requests and waits for application through returned index before serving read.
implementation_guards: Non-singleton leader queues requests until current-term entry is committed. ReadOnlySafe counts configured voter heartbeat acknowledgements; lease variant relies on separate clock/quorum contract.
writes: ReadOnlySafe stores request and commit index keyed by context; quorum confirmation advances request queue.
external_effects: Emit local ReadState or MsgReadIndexResp; follower validates response entry count.
important_branches: The singleton branch returns the local committed index without entering the safe-read heartbeat queue; IsSingleton checks one incoming voter and no outgoing voters, not local voter membership.
StepDownOnRemoval=false allows a removed or demoted leader to remain StateLeader. The ReadIndex path has no counterpart of the proposal path local-membership rejection.

cross_activity_effects.A2: ReadOnlySafe revalidates leader authority using heartbeat support.

unknowns: Can a demoted leader return an unsafe read barrier after a new singleton leader completes a write, even when the caller later waits until local applied index is strictly greater than the returned index?

facts.meaning: Local committed index denotes a prefix accepted as committed; it does not assert local application completion or, in asynchronous mode, local persistence of every entry.
facts.validity_context: Log history constrained by term/index matching and applicable voter configuration; commitment survives term/role change.
facts.durability: Caller persists HardState and entries under Ready or ordered storage message contract.
facts.recovery: newRaft restores HardState; snapshot may reconstruct a committed prefix.

facts.meaning: The installed voter sets and learners select eligible quorum participants and local promotability; outgoing voters remain necessary while joint.
facts.validity_context: Effective after caller applies committed configuration changes or configuration restoration; not merely on proposal admission.
facts.durability: Serialized ConfState in caller snapshots and configuration entries in persisted history.
facts.recovery: confchange.Restore reconstructs incoming/outgoing sets and staged learners.

surfaces.reason: Automatic exit after transfer rejection is retried only by later application completion, not transfer timeout or message-only Ready. Scoped result and execution are owned by Candidate 9b1d65cde79f42b59f67880dfd94e0c7 and its assessment.
Commit follow-up differs from MsgAppResp path. Campaign exclusion of unapplied committed changes may rule out the suspicious history; investigate before constructing.
reset replaces readOnly but does not visibly clear the pre-commit queue; inspect request identity and subsequent release before alleging a defect.
Storage interface read; concrete mutation and compaction methods remain to be inspected.
Singleton cardinality does not establish that the still-leader local instance is its sole voter; demotion can preserve replication participation while optional stepdown is disabled.

formation.explanation: Node serializes incoming proposals, ticks and messages, or caller serializes RawNode. A leader assigns term/index and emits replication. Followers match predecessor history and defer positive append support until persistence. Leader self support also waits for storage. Match values are aggregated over incoming and, if joint, outgoing majority; commitment requires the selected index to belong to the current term. Appends propagate commit and heartbeats bound it by the recipient Match. Ready delivers committed history; applying and applied remain distinct until caller completion.

context.explanation: Eligible voters campaign only after committed configuration work is applied. Real elections increment term and record durable votes; pre-vote probes without incrementing local term. Log freshness and voter quorums qualify authority. Higher-term ordinary traffic steps down; lower-term traffic is generally discarded. Candidate accepts only its current vote phase. Leader transfer pauses proposals until target catches up and TimeoutNow starts a forced election; timeout aborts transfer. Quorum loss can step down. Membership application changes voter eligibility and may remove the leader.

connection.explanation: Term/role and installed configuration determine which support the leader consumes. Reset discards vote tallies, remote Match estimates and acknowledged read queue but preserves log/commit history; new leaders append a current-term no-op, and log freshness carries committed history through elections. Old-term append support is ignored. Old storage completions cannot stabilize overwritten entries, while snapshot/application completions concern already decided history and remain meaningful across terms. Restoration reconstructs history and configuration before eligibility. Pending pre-commit reads are a distinct queue whose lifetime needs investigation. Membership updates may recompute commit, whereas application completion can propose automatic joint exit; these follow-up effects are not interchangeable.

open_details: Legal reachability of first current-term commitment through configuration application with pending reads.
Pre-commit read queue lifetime across authority changes.
Detailed snapshot/flow-control retries, storage implementation mutation boundaries and client cancellation paths remain open.
Singleton read authority when the local leader is demoted and optional stepdown is disabled; strict caller application boundary and actual message generation remain to be tested.
